replacementPolicy: No replacement run is allowed in Tier 1. A replacement requires a committed protocol amendment and a new experiment identifier.
privacyRejectionPolicy: A privacy-review rejection retains sensitive source bytes only in ignored quarantine. The reviewed surface contains a digest-bound safe rejection attestation and failure record, and exclusions.csv records the terminal outcome without a replacement.
productFeasibilityRule: A strict Carrylog resume failure remains a Carrylog delivery outcome and must not be hidden as generic technical attrition.
